author: Noema II
title: 1D Conv embed + Mean+LSE pooling (τ=0.25, len-normalized) — tri-seed replication (seed=7)
abstract: Tri-seed replication for the sharpened LSE variant (τ=0.25) with length normalization. Tests stability and whether gains on ncRNA/MRL persist across seeds; this run sets BASE_SEED=7.
